# ubuntu_apt_repository Resource

Manages a apt_repository resource via the hostsession.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "ubuntu_apt_repository" "example" {
  target = var.host
  uri = "https://dl.yarnpkg.com/debian/"
  suite = "stable"
  components = ["main"]
  update_cache = true
}
```
## Argument Reference

The resource supports the following arguments:

- `allow_destructive_destroy` (Optional, bool) - Explicitly allow destructive destroy for protected or side-effecting host objects managed by this resource.
- `architectures` (Optional, list(string)) - Optional architectures filter for the repository.
- `components` (Optional, list(string)) - Repository components such as stable or main.
- `ensure` (Optional, Computed, string) - Desired repository outcome (present or absent). Defaults to present.
- `name` (Optional, Computed, string) - Optional repository file basename. Defaults to a value derived from uri.
- `port` (Optional, int64) - Target port for this resource. Overrides provider default_target.port.
- `signed_by` (Optional, string) - Optional keyring path rendered as signed-by in the source entry.
- `signed_by_key_url` (Optional, string) - Optional URL for the repository signing key. When set, the host installs the keyring at signed_by.
- `suite` (Optional, Computed, string) - APT suite or distribution path. Defaults to the host VERSION_CODENAME.
- `target` (Optional, string) - Target host or address for this resource. Overrides provider default_target.target.
- `transport` (Optional, string) - Transport for this resource. The current provider surface supports ssh.
- `update_cache` (Optional, Computed, bool) - Refresh apt metadata after changing the repository.
- `uri` (Required, string) - APT repository base URI.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes:

- `file_path` (string) - Path to the managed sources.list.d file.
- `id` (string) - Unique identifier for this resource.
- `source_line` (string) - Rendered deb source line.
